messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SLO breach detected for streaming endpoint /v1/chat/stream in eu-west-3. p99 > 1s, p95 elevated. Paging on-call: @mica_oncall. Please join bridge if needed.

mica_oncall: joining. grabbing dashboards and routing logs. any customer reports? @tina_support?

tina_support: Affected customers in EU seeing long stall times and occasional stream resets since ~23:12 UTC. No increase in 500s. Sending live message to CS for notice.

arjun_eng: Router telemetry shows disproportionate traffic to lb-node-21 in eu-west-3. CPU ~35% but connection queue skyrocketed. Looks like load balancer sticky assignment for some prefixes: hot-bucket-42.

mel_sre: Could be the weight-override-v3 rollout that went live at 23:05. That changed shard affinity heuristics. Check rollout tags.

arjun_eng: Confirmed: weight-override-v3 enabled region sticky for certain tenant prefixes. Hash seed changed, causing subset traffic to prefer lb-node-21 -> hot partition.

mica_oncall: Options: rollback weight-override-v3, soft-drain lb-node-21, increase worker count, or apply fast patch to remove sticky seed. Fastest?

arjun_eng: Rollback is simplest. If we can flip config quickly, traffic will rebalance. I'll prepare rollback.

ops_bot: rollback request received: config weight-override-v3 -> weight-override-v2 in eu-west-3. Performing staged flip. Estimated 30-50s to propagate.

mel_sre: While that runs, soft-drain lb-node-21 to prevent new sticky allocations. Command: `POST /ops/api/drain?node=lb-node-21&duration=300`

arjun_eng: Executed soft-drain. New allocations should avoid lb-node-21 after ~8s. Observing connection backlog now.

mica_oncall: p99 trending down: 1200ms -> 640ms -> 280ms in ~90s. Streaming resets dropping.

ops_bot: rollback completed successfully. weight-override-v2 re-enabled in eu-west-3. No deployment errors.

tina_support: Sent update to customers: short apology, mitigation performed (rollback + drain), suggested reconnect for streaming sessions. One customer asked for timeline and RCA.

customer_success: Noted. They'll want a detailed postmortem. Marking as high-priority for follow-up.

arjun_eng: Root cause (draft): weight-override-v3 introduced an unintended sticky hash seed for prefix ranges mapping to hot-bucket-42; caused allocation skew to lb-node-21, queue buildup, and downstream streaming stalls and p99 blowup.

mica_oncall: Action items: 1) postmortem + RCA (owner: @arjun_eng) 2) add canary guard to detect >3x shard concentration 3) add a rollout blocker for sticky-seed changes 4) notify affected customers with timeline and mitigations within 24h.

mel_sre: I'll add an alert rule: if top-1 shard load > 4x median across region for 60s -> auto-rollback hook.

arjun_eng: Also will add a unit test for hash-seed invariance and a preprocessing check in canary jobs.

mica_oncall: Marking incident mitigated. Keeping P1 until POAM closed. If telemetry regresses, reopen immediately. Thanks all. :+1:

IncidentBot: Incident mitigated at 23:15 UTC. SLOs recovering. Postmortem owner: @arjun_eng.
